messages:
Amanda Li: Heads-up everyone — Hosted Edge Gateway (v1) is GA as of 09:00 PT. This provides regional low-latency routing and pre-warmed inference pools for APAC and EU. Rolling rollout schedule included below. Please read if you own SDKs, docs, or oncall.

Raj Patel: Is there any change customers need to make to call the new gateway?

Amanda Li: No mandatory changes. The API surface is the same but we added an optional X-Region header and a new endpoint path /v2/edge for region-specific routing. Default behavior stays backward compatible.

Amanda Li: Example request (curl):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "X-Region: eu-fr" \
     -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite","input":"Explain rocket staging in simple terms"}' \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v2/edge/generate
```

OpsBot: rollout: canary eu-fr 5% -> 20% (1987720120) :sparkles:

Sara Nguyen: Pricing impact? Any new line items?

Amanda Li: There is a small per-token regional surcharge for MiniGateway routes to cover pre-warmed capacity. Most customers will see net latency improvements and often lower egress. Full internal PRICING note: https://redwood.internal/pricing/edge-gateway.

Chris Morales: Are SLAs different for regional routes? How do we page?

Amanda Li: SLA unchanged for paid plans. We added edge-region-critical and edge-region-warning alerts. Oncall rota updated — see runbook. If regional errors exceed threshold we will failover to the standard global endpoint automatically.

DevEx Bot: SDK updates published: redwood-js@0.9.4 and redwood-py@0.9.4. Node sample: 
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ basePath: 'https://api.redwood.ai/v2/edge', region: 'ap-sg' });
await client.generate({ model: 'mosaic-lite', prompt: '...' });
```

Ben Ortiz: Rollback plan? Who owns the kill switch?

Amanda Li: Ops owns kill-switch. Rollback triggers: persistent error rate >3% over 5m, p95 latency > 2x baseline, or >10 VIP customer complaints flagged. Rollback steps: disable edge routing feature-flag -> traffic shifts to standard hosted endpoints. Contact @Chris Morales to coordinate.

Raj Patel: Observability — what dashboards do we have?

Amanda Li: Console -> Observability -> Edge Gateway shows per-region token usage, model distribution, p50/p95 latency, cold-start rate, and cache hit ratio. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

DeployBot: schedule: regions -> ap-sg, eu-fr, us-west over 72h (1987720200).

Sara Nguyen: Customer comms — auto-migrate or explicit opt-in?

Amanda Li: Self-serve customers will be migrated automatically but can opt-out. Enterprise CSMs will receive the rollout notes and a test window. Marketing comms draft in the shared drive.

Ben Ortiz: Security/compliance notes?

Amanda Li: Gateway supports KMS-backed key storage and preserves audit logs. For regulated customers, MiniGateway will be opt-in only. Security team reviewed and signed off; see security doc link.

Chris Morales: Added a short oncall checklist to the runbook and a play for region failover.

Amanda Li: Action items: SDK owners, update & verify clients by EOD tomorrow. Oncall folks, review runbook. CSMs, prepare customer notes. Ping me or Ben for staging creds. Thanks! :thumbsup:

OpsBot: note: edge-region-warning alert created in PagerDuty (1987720300).

Amanda Li: Links: docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/edge-gateway-ga, runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-gateway, pricing: https://redwood.internal/pricing/edge-gateway
